biography.plain_text: Philippe Henri Chettou is a French businessman whose career in Thailand spans telecommunications and marine tourism. He served as managing director of Alcatel Thailand before becoming a director of Phuket-based yacht charter business Alpha Superyachts. His business career also included service among France’s foreign trade advisers in Thailand, following an appointment in 2002.

long_biography.plain_text:
Philippe Chettou started Aquamarine Divers in October 2004, shortly before the Indian Ocean tsunami disrupted tourism across the region. During the recovery, he described weak diving bookings and the economic damage caused by reports that exaggerated destruction in Phuket. His new business depended on convincing travellers that the destination remained accessible.

Chettou promoted Southeast Asia’s cruising grounds through the yacht charter business Alpha Superyachts. At the inaugural Singapore Yacht Show, he described working with partners to attract visitors accustomed to the Mediterranean and Caribbean. The company offered motor and sailing vessels for charter, while Aquamarine’s services combined liveaboard accommodation with diving and snorkelling trips.
